scope: Obstfeld and Rogoff (1996), Chapter 3: the life cycle, tax policy, and the current account. Ricardian equivalence (two-period and infinite-horizon) and Barro altruism with Gale's non-uniqueness; its failure in the two-period OLG economy, saving accounting and generational accounting; the debt-financed transfer (3.24)-(3.32); growth, demographics and saving; the small open Diamond economy; gains from trade across generations with the corrected Exercise 2(b); global stability of the two-country OLG model and public debt with the omitted debt threshold; Weil's perpetual youth and Blanchard's model; dynamic inefficiency, Ponzi games and bubbles; Barro tax smoothing. Exercises 1-6.
source: Maurice Obstfeld and Kenneth Rogoff (1996), Foundations of International Macroeconomics, MIT Press, Chapter 3, pp. 129-197.
